posts.post_subject: Two wavelenght Greek god and background.
posts.content_md:
Since I didn't post a photo of the two overlapping light bulbs with different wavelengths and I had a plate left, I thought I might try a two color overlap again. 

I agree that keeping the greek god in place when shooting the background but color him black would be a great way to make him look solid and defintely worth a try. Maybe next time.

Greek God in 457, background "stuff" in 514. Looks like too much 514 and not enough 457. He is definitely green with the backgound organge. Where there are dark spots in the background he is real green. WHere the backgound shows through him you see orange and he is still tinted green. Again, I don't like it.

![Image](http://www.holograms3d.com/PhotoGal/General/GreekwClouds.JPG)
